nonStandardPatterns.pattern: banner banner-info (intensified official control banner above main)
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Shows the intensified-official-control heading, linked commodity/establishment/test details and the instruction to select the commodity.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: This conditional information panel uses legacy custom banner classes rather than a GOV.UK notification banner and sits outside the main element.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: GOV.UK Notification banner placed within main, preserving the trace-confirmed copy and commodity link.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 173; trace ba5323fd63dcda25ee5e37c013c511d2949410bc action 156 (after snapshot)

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom BEM modifier on the govuk-notification-banner, styling the 'Inspection required' banner (likely a distinct colour/emphasis from the default grey/blue notification banner)
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Bespoke IPAFFS styling extending a standard component; the new app would need its own CSS or a govuk-frontend-supported variant to reproduce it
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Standard Notification banner (with default or --success variant), or Warning text / Inset text depending on intent

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom modifier making the banner content span full width rather than the default constrained width
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Non-standard layout override on the banner content region
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use grid columns to control width instead of overriding the banner internal layout

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom class wrapping the reference number + version caption span inside the H1 (CHEDP.GB.2026.1525975 - V1)
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Bespoke class used as a caption within the heading rather than the standard govuk-caption-* pattern

nonStandardPatterns.pattern: govuk-radios__conditional wrapping a Character count whose label is an <h1>
nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: The 'Additional details (optional)' character-count field sits inside the conditional reveal; its govuk-label-wrapper is an <h1> element (govuk-frontend default macro markup when labelIsPageHeading is set), producing a second, visually-styled-as-label <h1> in the DOM
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Two <h1> elements exist on the page (the real page H1 and this label-wrapper H1). Semantically a page should have one H1; the label should not be an H1 when it is not the page heading
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Render the character-count label as a plain govuk-label (labelIsPageHeading=false)

fields.name: document-check-result
fields.label: Documentary check
fields.requiredEvidence: Mandatory for CHED-P model validation: documentCheckResult is @NotNull for NotificationCedOrCvedpFieldValidation (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/ConsignmentCheck.java:100-109). The page-specific Joi validator only checks additional-details length and therefore defers this requirement to model validation (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/consignment_eu_doc_check_validation.js:9-29). This is old-system model policy for the rebuild to confirm.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 173 (Satisfactory); trace ba5323fd63dcda25ee5e37c013c511d2949410bc action 157 (Not satisfactory). Radio input values: Satisfactory=1, Satisfactory following official intervention=8, Not satisfactory=2, Not done=7. HTML radios carry no `required` attribute. QA locators independently identify Satisfactory and Not satisfactory at page-objects/decision/DocumentaryCheckPage.ts:6 and page-objects/decision/DocumentaryCheckPage.ts:10; CHED-P permit/reject workflows exercise both at workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:1164 and workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:1190.

fields.name: document-check-additional-details
fields.label: Additional details (optional)
fields.requiredEvidence: Explicitly optional in the authorised page validator: document-check-additional-details is Joi.string().allow('').max(150), with no .required() rule (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/consignment_eu_doc_check_validation.js:18-25). The model field documentCheckAdditionalDetails has no @NotNull annotation (ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/ConsignmentCheck.java:166-170).
fields.conditionalOn: Only shown when 'Satisfactory following official intervention' (value 8) is selected — inside govuk-radios__conditional (id conditional-document-check-8, aria-controls on the radio)
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 173 (main.html). Character count component, data-maxlength=150, rows=5. Screen-reader hint: 'You can enter up to 150 characters.' No test in these two traces selected value 8, so the field was present but never filled. The QA page object has no locator for this textarea and no CHED-P workflow selects the official-intervention outcome, so its second-source behavior is a gap.

fields.name: crumb / etag
fields.label: (no visible label — hidden CSRF crumb and optimistic-concurrency etag in the documentary-check POST form)
fields.requiredEvidence: Framework-supplied CSRF/concurrency state, not a user-mandatory documentary-check value. The page validator accepts etag as Joi.any() and ignores crumb via allowUnknown=true (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/consignment_eu_doc_check_validation.js:9-15,27-29).
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 173 (control inventory: INPUT|hidden|crumb and INPUT|hidden|etag)

fields.name: crumb / returnUrl / fromFooterHeader (shared cookie form)
fields.label: (no visible label — hidden shared-chrome cookie-form fields)
fields.requiredEvidence: Shared page-chrome cookie-form state, not documentary-check data. The documentary-check handler reads neither returnUrl nor fromFooterHeader, and its validator allows unknown fields (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/routes/handlers/bip/consignment_eu_doc_check.js:40-80; service/src/validation/consignment_eu_doc_check_validation.js:9-15).
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 173 (control inventory: hidden crumb, returnUrl and fromFooterHeader after the page form)

validationMessages.trigger: CHED-P model validation runs without a documentary-check result.
validationMessages.evidence: Verbatim CHED-P model-validation copy at ipaffs-notification-microservice/service/src/main/resources/ValidationMessages.properties:150, selected by the @NotNull NotificationCedOrCvedpFieldValidation annotation at ipaffs-imports-notification-schema/notification-schema-java/src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/tracesx/notificationschema/representation/ConsignmentCheck.java:100-109.

validationMessages.message: Additional details must be 150 characters or less
validationMessages.trigger: Submitting more than 150 characters in Additional details.
validationMessages.evidence: Verbatim page-validation copy generated at ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/consignment_eu_doc_check_validation.js:18-25 and asserted exactly at service/test/validation/consignment_eu_doc_check_validation_test.js:16-24.

validationMessages.message: You can enter up to 150 characters.
validationMessages.trigger: Always-present character-count guidance in the visually-hidden info message #document-check-additional-details-info; this is guidance, not the over-limit validation error.
validationMessages.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 173 (main.html). The textarea's aria-describedby also references an `exceeding-characters-error` element (the over-limit error), which was not rendered/populated in these no-error traces. No QA test asserts either character-count or validation copy.

openQuestions: RESOLVED FROM LEGACY: CHED-P model validation requires documentCheckResult and emits the terse message "Documentary check" when it is absent (ConsignmentCheck.java:100-109; ValidationMessages.properties:150). The page-specific validator does not enforce the radio selection itself, so no friendlier page-level "select an outcome" copy exists in the authorised source.

RESOLVED FROM LEGACY: the over-limit message is "Additional details must be 150 characters or less" (ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/validation/consignment_eu_doc_check_validation.js:18-25; exact test assertion at service/test/validation/consignment_eu_doc_check_validation_test.js:16-24).

The 'Additional details' conditional textarea (revealed only under 'Satisfactory following official intervention', value 8) was never exercised in these two traces — its behaviour/persistence is confirmed structurally but not through a filled value.

'Save and continue' is corroborated by the CHED-P QA workflow and proceeds to Identity and physical checks (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:1081). 'Save and return' has no page-object locator or CHED-P test, so its return-to-hub behavior remains inferred from its label.

The 'Inspection required' notification banner content (commodities list, 'cannot override' message) is data-driven by the consignment's risk decision; it may not appear for consignments with no inspection required — that conditional was not varied across the two traces.

The shared DocumentaryCheckPage exposes #documentaryCheck1 and #documentaryCheck2 checkboxes at page-objects/decision/DocumentaryCheckPage.ts:14 and page-objects/decision/DocumentaryCheckPage.ts:18, but all usages are confined to CHED-D workflows. They were not added as CHED-P fields.

QA independently corroborates only the Satisfactory and Not satisfactory radio options. It has no locator or CHED-P test for Satisfactory following official intervention, Not done, or Additional details; those trace-confirmed definitions remain second-source gaps.

Legacy policy point: confirm that the rebuild should retain model-level mandatory documentary-check selection and replace or contextualise the old source message "Documentary check", which is exact but not instructive.

The complete authorised CHED-P branch in ipaffs-frontend-decision/service/src/views/bip/consignmentEuDocCheck.html:33-197 contains the four outcomes and optional 150-character Additional details field already captured. The extra intervention-reason radio set at lines 58-143 is guarded by isCveda and is not a missed CHED-P field; no missed field was added.
